decisions.reason: The responsive template draws on the firm's CMS know-how and costs little to keep, but it has not been visible since 2018 and its sister shop template was already dropped, so withdrawal is a real possibility.
Premium support extends the firm's core round-the-clock expert service, so it fits its existing knowledge closely and the firm can easily read customer uptake and refine the offer.
The version management tool builds on the firm's in-house software development and its tools for cutting operational work, which agencies value, so the firm has the knowledge to keep improving it.
Scalable agency hosting is the firm's flagship, sits squarely on its data center and hosting expertise, and matches its strategic direction, so dropping it is very unlikely.
